findings.title: Preserve or migrate the removed mark_failed module exports
findings.body: This refactor removes the previously importable `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `SimpleCheckIn` symbols from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, but does not provide compatibility re-exports or update any consumers outside these four files. Any existing worker, integration, or test importing one of those non-private symbols from the old module will now fail at import time. Re-export the moved symbols from the old module (or update every caller in the repository and any supported downstream integrations) before merging.
